company.shortDescription: Nimble is a data science company that helps school districts identify and hire teachers.
company.description:
Nimble is a data science company that helps school districts identify and hire teachers.

Nimble offers a data-driven applicant tracking system that makes hiring faster and smarter for school districts and charter networks nationwide.

Nimble was founded in 2017 was headquartered in California, United States.

productsAndServices.description: A connected hiring platform for state education agencies, school districts, principals, and teachers that supports teacher recruitment, candidate matching, applications, screening, and hiring.
productsAndServices.name: Nimble K-12 Hiring Platform

productsAndServices.description: A centralized job marketplace where teachers can find K-12 openings across participating states and apply using a single profile.
productsAndServices.name: Statewide Educator Job Board

productsAndServices.description: Data and guidance services that help education leaders monitor teacher vacancies, identify workforce shortages, and help aspiring educators understand routes into teaching.
productsAndServices.name: Teacher Workforce Intelligence and Pathway Support
